verses.he: הֲ֭זֹאת חָשַׁ֣בְתָּ לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט אָ֝מַ֗רְתָּ צִדְקִ֥י מֵאֵֽל׃
verses.en: Thinkest thou this to be thy right, Or sayest thou: ‘I am righteousness before God’,
That thou inquirest: ‘What advantage will it be unto Thee?’ And: ‘What profit shall I have, more than if I had sinned?’
I will give thee answer, And thy companions with thee.

verses.he: הַבֵּ֣ט שָׁמַ֣יִם וּרְאֵ֑ה וְשׁ֥וּר שְׁ֝חָקִ֗ים גָּבְה֥וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.en: Look unto the heavens, and see; And behold the skies, which are higher than thou.
If thou hast sinned, what doest thou against Him? And if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto Him?
If thou be righteous, what givest thou Him? Or what receiveth He of thy hand?
Thy wickedness concerneth a man as thou art; And thy righteousness a son of man.

verses.he: מֵ֭רֹב עֲשׁוּקִ֣ים יַזְעִ֑יקוּ יְשַׁוְּע֖וּ מִזְּר֣וֹעַ רַבִּֽים׃
verses.en: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out; They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

verses.he: וְֽלֹא־אָמַ֗ר אַ֭יֵּה אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֹשָׂ֑י נֹתֵ֖ן זְמִר֣וֹת בַּלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.en: But none saith: ‘Where is God my Maker, Who giveth songs in the night;

verses.he: מַ֭לְּפֵנוּ מִבַּהֲמ֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יְחַכְּמֵֽנוּ׃
verses.en: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, And maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?’

verses.he: שָׁ֣ם יִ֭צְעֲקוּ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י גְּא֣וֹן רָעִֽים׃
verses.en: There they cry, but none giveth answer, Because of the pride of evil men.

verses.he: אַךְ־שָׁ֭וְא לֹא־יִשְׁמַ֥ע׀ אֵ֑ל וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: Surely God will not hear vanity, Neither will the Almighty regard it.

verses.he: אַ֣ף כִּֽי־תֹ֖אמַר לֹ֣א תְשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ דִּ֥ין לְ֝פָנָ֗יו וּתְח֥וֹלֵֽל לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Yea, when thou sayest thou canst not see Him— The cause is before Him; therefore wait thou for Him.

verses.he: וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּי־אַ֭יִן פָּקַ֣ד אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־יָדַ֖ע בַּפַּ֣שׁ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.en: And now, is it for nought that He punished in His anger? And hath He not full knowledge of arrogance?

verses.he: וְ֭אִיּוֹב הֶ֣בֶל יִפְצֶה־פִּ֑יהוּ בִּבְלִי־דַ֝֗עַת מִלִּ֥ין יַכְבִּֽר׃
verses.en: But Job doth open his mouth in vanity; He multiplieth words without knowledge.
